llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only advisor and appears coherent and low-risk: it asks for no credentials and installs nothing. Still consider: 1) The skill is advisory only — always verify important legal/financial decisions with licensed professionals. 2) The agent may ask you for personal or financial details to give accurate advice; avoid providing highly sensitive data (Social Security numbers, full bank account credentials, authentication codes). 3) If you want real-time market data or integrations (MLS feeds, lender APIs), this skill does not include those — such capabilities would require additional skills and credentials. 4) If you are concerned about autonomous invocation, remember the platform default allows the model to call skills; change your agent settings if you want to restrict automatic use.
